summary: Avoid durable commits for unchanged replication receives and expose receive commit costs

replay.detail: Admission, repairs, signature processing and deferred projection draining retain their existing paths.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: No authorization or claim admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: Unchanged empty receipts checkpoint peer timestamps at a bounded interval while live liveness checks retain exact receipt times. Receive and commit counters have bounded exchange class and outcome labels.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated restart required.

recovery.detail: Changed metadata and inventory acknowledgements continue to persist immediately; normal replication retries remain idempotent.
